relays.name: Lunar Pathfinder
relays.operator: ESA, built and operated by Surrey Satellite Technology Ltd
relays.launch_note: To fly on Firefly's Blue Ghost Mission 2, integrated into its Elytra Dark orbital vehicle. ESA: launch not earlier than November 2026; SSTL: due to launch 2027.
relays.orbit_note: SSTL: 'a stable elliptical orbit to provide long duration visibility of the Southern Lunar Hemisphere each day' (an elliptical lunar frozen orbit). Its heights are ESA's; where its node and its place along the orbit will be is not published, so both are swept.

relays.name: Altus-1 data-relay satellite
relays.launch_note: Planned to fly alongside IM-3 (NASA, August 2026).
relays.orbit_note: NASA says only that Altus-1 is deployed 'in lunar orbit'. The orbit used here is assumed from NASA's reference design; where its node and its place along the orbit will be is swept.
